map.F = G·m₁·m₂/r²；地月引力约 1.98×10²⁰ N。: F = G*m1*m2/r^2; the Earth-Moon gravitational force is about 1.98x10^20 N.

map.对比近距与远距的引力衰减，理解平方反比律对天体轨道的影响。: Compare gravitational attenuation at short and long distances to understand how the inverse-square law shapes celestial orbits.

map.示例：两枚 1 kg 物体相距 1 m 的引力: Example: gravity between two 1 kg objects 1 m apart
map.：F=G·m₁·m₂/r²=6.674×10⁻¹¹·1·1/1²≈6.67×10: : F = G*m1*m2/r^2 = 6.674x10^-11 x 1 x 1/1^2, about 6.67x10^-11 N, extremely weak. If instead the Earth and a 1 kg object close to the surface are used, m2 = 5.97x10^24 and r = 6.37x10^6, giving F about 9.8 N (that is, the weight of about 1 kg).

map.引力为什么叫平方反比？: Why is gravity called an inverse-square law?
map.力的大小与距离的平方成反比，距离翻倍则引力减为四分之一，这是天体轨道稳定的核心规: Force is inversely proportional to the square of distance; doubling the distance reduces gravity to a quarter, the core law behind the stability of celestial orbits.
map.G 是什么，为什么这么小？: What is G and why is it so small?
map.G 是万有引力常数，数值极小说明日常尺度下引力远弱于电磁力，只在天体质量级才显著: G is the gravitational constant; its extremely small value shows that gravity is far weaker than electromagnetism at everyday scales and only becomes significant at astronomical masses.
